ios.desc:
RAW photos, your way. Unpro takes beautiful pictures with customizable filters and tons of options.

== Customizable Presets Engine ==

Capture detailed natural photos and process them through Unpro’s all-new Presets engine. Choose from a variety of built-in Presets to get the right mood for your scene, or adjust and create your own using the Preset Customizer. Enable and fine-tune filmic grain, chromatic aberration, lens blur, saturation, and more with precision. There’s even LUT support, so you can import looks created by others and combine them with your own custom filter pipeline. 

Best of all, Presets are all previewed right in the viewfinder, so you don’t have to wait to see how your photos look with them!

== Sophisticated Photo Rendering ==

With Unpro, get control over your capture format, shoot RAW and (on supporting devices) ProRAW, and automatically get great results thanks to Unpro’s dynamic custom processing pipeline. Without filters, Unpro produces photos that look the closest thing to what you see with your eyes, skipping the hideous sharpening and overbearing local tone-mapping. With filters, the processing combines with your chosen Preset to produce naturalistic, beautifully-rendered film-like photos.

== An Unpro Original Feature: RAW+ Capture ==

Unpro Camera introduces a novel capture mode to iPhone: RAW + ProRAW (or RAW + Deprocessed on non-Pro iPhone models). No longer choose between the limited but authentic look of RAW vs the dynamic range and detail of computational photography; snap RAW and ProRAW/Deprocessed photos in rapid succession, capturing your scene both ways. Now you have the freedom to choose your favorite later.

== Power Features For Power Users ==

Want to save RAW photo data alongside your JPEGs, for greater editing flexibility? Want to adjust exposure bias with just a swipe, or customize the rendering of RAW photos down to the shadow boosting and color noise reduction? Unpro has you covered with that and much more.

== Stylish Retro UI ==

Unpro adopts a skeuomorphic design philosophy inspired by DSLRs. The key is buttons that don’t move around, so they’re quick to access no matter what the state of the camera or the orientation of your device.

== No AI ==

I’m too lazy to figure out how to incorporate AI into Unpro.

RAW photos, your way: Unpro Camera.

quotes.text:
I find the default HDR (as in gain map) presentation of iPhone photos to look rather garish, rendering highlights too bright and distracting from the content of the images. The solution I came up with for my own camera app was to roll off and lower the highlights in the gain map, which results in final images that I find way more pleasing. This seems to be somewhat similar to what Halide is introducing with their "Standard" option for HDR.

Hopefully HN allows me to share an App Store link... this app works best on Pro iPhones, which support ProRAW, although I do some clever stuff on non-Pro iPhones to get a more natural look.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unpro-camera/id6535677796

I've been working on an iOS camera app to take natural-looking photos with reduced post-processing. The goal is take photos that look like what you see.

I just updated the RAW pipeline and I'm really happy with how the resulting photos look, plus there's this cool "RAW+ProRAW" capture mode I introduced recently.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unpro-camera/id6535677796

I initially released it early last year and have been using it as my main camera app since, but I haven't mentioned it in one of these threads before. Unfortunately this post has come just a bit early for my most recent update to be approved; there's some nice improvements coming.
